statement: Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote probes normal accessory identity via A400FA, inactive MP via A600FA, maps MotionPlus with A600FE 04/05/07 and exposes MP ABS_RX/RY/RZ evdev. SDL 3.2.10 Wii HIDAPI reads active mapped identity and converts report gyro with fixed rates; its Linux activation function intentionally does not send A600FE or update the private mode. In these reviewed paths neither requires Dolphin's A400F6/4 or A40040/16. xwiimote consumes kernel evdev values while RetroArch's udev sensor classification can suppress RXYZ-only gyro; these are not independent raw protocol tests.

applicability.revision: Pinned consumer implementations in docs/wii-motionplus-consumer-comparison.md; no physical Wii Remote revision measured
